text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I happen upon Fuji Kiseki on my way
home. She
invites me to watch an
outdoor play, so I agree to
join her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
She's so good... Her singing and
acting—no, every
part of her
performance is stupendous!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The lead is a friend of my mother's.
I've
known her since I was young.
choice_data_list: 知り合いが出てたのか？

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I saw her. Would
it be all
right if I went to say hi?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hello! Long time no see.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
Why, if it isn't Fuji! Thanks for coming. ♪
You've
become even more beautiful
since the last time I
saw you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, but having seen your
performance
today, I know I'm no match
for you.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
Why, you've not only grown more
beautiful, but
your tongue's grown more
gilded too! And who
might this be?

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you're her trainer, are you?
Hmm... Very
interesting.
choice_data_list: フジキセキのトレーナーです

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text: She's quite the handful, is she not?

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
Why, we used to call this little imp
"Prince
Mischief" in our company.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
She would scare the cast by hanging
prop spiders
above their heads during
breaks in rehearsal!

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
Then again, her pranks did help
everyone laugh
and shake off their
nerves, so there's that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That was so long ago. I don't pull
such
childish pranks anymore.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
Really now? It's a shame to think we'll
never be
able to see that sweet prince
again.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, not you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
You two are so close. ♪ It's a real treat
to see
your bond together. Now then,
please excuse me.
I have to change!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Sorry to keep you. I'll be sure
to watch
your show if you ever have
another performance
nearby.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
You are such a dear. Thank you. Oh, one
moment.
I'd like a word with your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm? Okay...

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
...I wanted her to become an actor, you
know.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
I hoped that one day I could perform
alongside
her in a supporting role while
she took the stage
as the lead in a play
for the ages.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
The thought that I'll never be able to do
that has
been upsetting... but I feel
much better now after
speaking with her.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
She looked so happy. It must be because
she's
found a wonderful trainer and a
home that makes
her happier than the
stage did.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
All of us from the theatre hope you'll
take good
care of her. She's the apple of
our eyes, and we
leave her to you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back. So, what'd you two talk
about?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me she was telling you more

embarrassing stories from when I was
young.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I knew it! So she was gossiping about me! What did she tell you?
choice_data_list: いろいろ弱点を教えてもらった
公演の楽しみ方を教えてもらっただけ

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Is it now? Well, if I had to guess what
you were
talking about... Oh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Did she tell you something trivial, like
how I
actually hate wearing high heels
and used to
throw tantrums about it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm, so that's a no...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Was it about the curtain? Maybe it was
about
that one time we had five
consecutive shows...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, whatever. They may be tricks I
played as a
child, but I must own up to
them regardless.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I don't think you'd leak my
secrets
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She winks at me, and that effectively
seals my
lips. Not that I ever doubted
her, but she really
does have the true
makings of an actor.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I'm sure she did!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Did you really think I would believe
that?
You're so bad at lying.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Liars are good at seeing through lies,
and the
best entertainers also happen to
be the best liars
as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since I couldn't trick her, I tell her about
her
friend's dream and the wish she's
entrusted me
with.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So she wanted to perform with me...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That future could have very well been a
reality...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
However, I chose to walk a different
path. But,
since she's giving me her
blessing and wishing the
best for me...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to become an even greater
entertainer
on the turf than the actors
we saw on stage today!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right! Let's make me the best version of
myself
ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stage isn't the only place Fuji Kiseki
can
impress her fans. We chat about our
future plans
the whole way home.
